blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing paired clean-degraded datasets have advanced learning-based underwater image enhancement, but they remain either limited in scale or difficult to acquire, and still fail to adequately cover the diverse degradations encountered in real-world underwater environments. Such scarce and insufficient data ultimately restrict the generalization of underwater image enhancement models, highlighting the need for realistic and controllable degradation modeling to better capture real underwater conditions and improve enhancement robustness. To this end, we propose a unified degradation-aware training framework for the underwater image enhancement task. A Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation Pipeline uses a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize diverse and semantically consistent degraded samples, providing paired data to support the subsequent curriculum learning strategy. The proposed Progressive Degradation Curriculum organizes training across multiple attributes and difficulty levels to promote balanced learning, and a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion Model leverages this progressive process to better address the wide range of degradation severity and restoration ambiguity in underwater images. Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance. Our code and models will be released upon the publication of this work.
blocks.zh: 现有对等的清洁分级数据集具有先进的以学习为基础的水下图像增强功能,但它们在规模上仍然有限或难以获得,仍然未能充分涵盖现实世界水下环境中所遭遇的各种分级. 这种稀缺和不足的数据最终限制了水下图像增强模型的通俗化,突出表明需要现实和可控制的降解模型来更好地捕捉水下的真实条件并增强增强强度. 为此,我们提议为水下图像增强任务建立一个统一的降解意识训练框架。 一个有文字条件的降解增强管道使用文字指导的传播模型来合成多样的和精密相容的退化样本,提供配对数据支持后续的课程学习战略. 拟议的 " 渐进退化课程 " 组织多种属性和困难层次的培训,以促进均衡的学习, " 传输指导 " 的 " 一步传播模式 " 利用这一渐进进程,更好地解决水下图像中广泛的退化严重性和恢复模糊问题。 对多个水下基准的广泛实验表明,我们提议的方法取得了优异的性能. 我们的代码和模型将在这部作品出版后发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Underwater Image Enhancement (UIE) aims to recover clear, color-consistent, and detail-preserving images from degraded underwater observations.
Unlike uniform degradations in common image restoration tasks, underwater degradations are highly heterogeneous and scene-dependent, where they vary with water type, depth, illumination, and particle density, and often exhibit complex spatial coupling among these factors. Consequently, the underlying degradation distribution is extremely difficult to model or approximate with a fixed prior, making UIE an intrinsically ill-posed and data-sensitive problem.
blocks.zh:
水下图像增强(UIE)旨在从已退化的水下观测中恢复清晰、相容和详细保存的图像。
与常见图像还原任务中的统一降解不同,水下降解高度多变并依地而生,在水型,深度,发光,和粒子密度等方面各不相同,并经常在这些因素之间表现出复杂的空间耦合. 因此,根本的退化分布极难与固定的先期模型相模拟或相近,从而使世界免疫单位成为一个内在的不可用和对数据敏感的问题。

blocks.en:
Over the past decade, a wide range of enhancement approaches have been explored, spanning from physics-based restoration guided by analytical priors Drews et al. (2013) ; Galdran et al. (2015) ; Chiang and Chen (2011) to deep learning-based methods trained on paired datasets Li et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2021) ; Wang et al. (2021) ; Zhang et al. (2022) ; Wei et al. (2022) ; Li et al. (2019a) .
While the former provides physical interpretability, it fails to generalize across diverse water types and illumination conditions.
The latter achieves stronger visual quality through elaborately designed networks but relies heavily on limited paired data.
blocks.zh:
在过去十年中,探索了广泛的增强方法,从以Drews等人(2013年)、Galdran等人(2015年)、Chiang和Chen(2011年)为导师的物理修复到对等数据集的深层学习方法(2020年)、Li等人(2021年)、Wang等人(2021年); 张等 (2022); 魏等 (2022); 李等 (2019a).
虽然前者提供了物理解释性,但未能将各种取水类型和照明条件概括起来。
后者通过精心设计的网络实现更高的视觉质量,但在很大程度上依赖于有限的对等数据。

blocks.en: Acquiring paired underwater data is inherently challenging because capturing the same scene under both degraded and clean conditions is almost impossible in dynamic environments. As illustrated in Figure 1 -Top, such pairs are commonly obtained through (i) controlled water-tank capture Duarte et al. (2016) , (ii) pseudo-reference generation by manually selecting outputs from multiple UIE methods Li et al. (2019a) ; Peng et al. (2023) , or (iii) synthetic rendering with simplified underwater formation models Islam et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2017) ; Ye et al. (2022) ; Li et al. (2020) . The first two routes provide visually realistic supervision but are costly and difficult to scale, whereas the third enables scalable generation but often fails to reproduce the complex lighting and scattering effects of natural underwater scenes.
blocks.zh: 获得对等的水下数据本身具有挑战性,因为在动态环境中几乎不可能在退化和清洁的条件下捕获同一场景。 如图1-Top所示,通常通过(一)受控水箱捕获Duarte等人(2016年),(二)通过人工从多种UIE方法Li等人(2019年a),Peng等人(2023年),或(三)用简化的水下形成模型Islam等人(2020年)合成渲染,Li等人(2017年),Ye等人(2022年),Li等人(2020年)。 前两条航道提供目视现实的监管,但成本高而难以扩展,而第三道航道则能够进行可伸缩的发电,但往往无法复制水下自然场景的复杂照明和散射效应。

blocks.en:
These limitations reveal that the main bottleneck of UIE lies not only in model architecture but also in the lack of realistic and controllable degradation modeling for generating diverse training variants.
Moreover, underwater degradations vary drastically in strength and composition—ranging from light color cast to dense scattering and mixed turbidity.
This motivates us to rethink UIE — not as direct restoration, but as learning from degradation , where controllable, text-guided degradation modeling provides structured, degradation-aware supervision for enhancement learning.
In addition, we argue that if degradations can be explicitly modeled and controlled, they can serve as a meaningful curriculum for enhancement, where the model gradually adapts to increasingly challenging degradations across multiple attributes and severity levels, which encourages more generalized enhancement performance.
blocks.zh:
这些限制表明,国际兽疫局的主要瓶颈不仅在于模型结构,而且在于缺乏产生各种培训变体的现实和可控制的退化模型。
此外,水下退化在强度和组成上差异很大,从浅色铸造到密集的散射和混合的混凝土。
这促使我们重新思考UIE——不是直接恢复,而是从退化中学习,在退化中,可控的、以文字指导的退化模型为增强学习提供了结构化的、具有退化意识的监督。
此外,我们主张,如果退化可以被明确模型化和控制,那么它们可以作为一个有意义的增强课程,在该课程中,模型逐渐适应在多种属性和严重程度层次上日益具有挑战性的退化,这鼓励了更普遍的增强性能.

blocks.en:
To this end, we revisit underwater enhancement from a new perspective-leveraging the generative capability of the diffusion model to explicitly model and control underwater degradations (Figure 1 -Medium).
Diffusion-based generative models Labs et al. (2025) provide an expressive latent space in which degradations can be synthesized and conditioned on semantic cues such as turbidity, illumination, or particle density.
This text-conditioned formulation enables fine-grained control over degradation attributes and supports large-scale data augmentation aligned with real underwater characteristics.
The generated degradations further provide difficulty-aware cues that guide enhancement models to learn progressively under well-structured degradation distributions, yielding more stable optimization and visually coherent restoration across diverse underwater conditions.
Moreover, we develop a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion enhancer that injects a transmission prior into the latent space and performs a single deterministic reverse update, providing transmission-guided restoration with lower sampling cost than multi-step diffusion methods.
Together, these designs establish a cohesive paradigm that unifies controllable degradation modeling and physically guided enhancement, offering a new perspective on the UIE task.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们从新的视角中重新审视水下增强作用,利用扩散模型的分基因能力,明确模拟和控制水下退化(图1-中)。
基于分泌的基因模型Labs等人(2025年)提供了一个可被分解的表达性潜在空间,在分解中可以被合成并被以等语义提示为条件,如:分解、发光或粒子密度等.
这种有文字条件的配方能够对降解属性进行精细控制,并支持与真正的水下特性相适应的大规模数据增强.
由此产生的退化进一步提供了困难意识提示,指导增强模型在结构良好的退化分布下逐步学习,在不同的水下条件下产生更稳定的优化和视觉连贯的恢复。
此外,我们开发了一种传输导出一阶扩散增强器,在潜在空间之前将传输注入,并进行单一的确定性反向更新,提供传输导出还原,其采样成本低于多步骤扩散方法。
这些设计共同确立了一种统一的模式,统一了可控制的退化模型和物理引导的增强,为世界环境倡议的任务提供了新的视角。

blocks.en: Overall, our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We introduce a Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation (TCDA) pipeline that leverages a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize controllable degraded variants of clean images, enabling fine-grained attribute/severity control for task-aligned data augmentation. • We employ a progressive degradation curriculum learning that gradually increases training difficulty, stabilizing optimization and improving the model’s robustness. • We design a Transmission-Guided One-step Diffusion model (TG-Diff) that embeds a transmission prior into the latent space, achieving high-quality restoration with greater inference efficiency than multi-step diffusion methods. • Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们引入了 " 有文字条件的退化增强 " 管道,利用文字指导的传播模型来合成清洁图像的可控制的退化变体,从而能够对任务相通的数据增强进行精细的属性/严重程度控制。 我们采用渐进式的退化课程学习,逐步增加培训难度,稳定优化,提高模式的稳健性。 我们设计了一种传输引导单步扩散模型(TG-DIff),将传输嵌入到潜入空间之前,实现高质量的还原,其推论效率高于多步扩散方法. • 对多个水下基准的广泛试验表明,我们的方法达到了最先进的性能。

blocks.en: We introduce a Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation (TCDA) pipeline that leverages a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize controllable degraded variants of clean images, enabling fine-grained attribute/severity control for task-aligned data augmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 " 文本条件降解增强 " (TCDA)管道,利用文本指导传播模型合成可控制的可降解的清洁图像变体,从而能够对任务相匹配的数据增强进行精度属性/严重程度控制。

blocks.en: We employ a progressive degradation curriculum learning that gradually increases training difficulty, stabilizing optimization and improving the model’s robustness.
blocks.zh: 我们采用渐进式的退化课程学习,逐步增加培训难度,稳定优化,提高模式的稳健性.

blocks.en: We design a Transmission-Guided One-step Diffusion model (TG-Diff) that embeds a transmission prior into the latent space, achieving high-quality restoration with greater inference efficiency than multi-step diffusion methods.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一种传输引导单步扩散模型(TG-DIff),将传输嵌入到潜入空间之前,实现高质量的还原,其推论效率高于多步扩散方法.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 对多个水下基准的广泛实验表明,我们的方法实现了最先进的性能.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Overview of the proposed Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation (TCDA) pipeline.
It consists of four stages: (1) Degradation Captioning via MLLMs for generating fine-grained textual descriptions of underwater degradations, (2) Flow-Based Degradation Modeling for learning text-conditioned mappings between clean and degraded representations, (3) Prompt-Space Augmentation for enriching degradation prompts with varying difficulty levels, and (4) Text-Conditioned Degradation Synthesis for controllable degradation generation to support curriculum learning.
blocks.zh:
图2:拟议文本条件降解增强管道概述。
它包括四个阶段: (1) 通过MLLMs对降解进行描述,以产生关于水下降解的精细文字描述;(2) 以流为基的降解模型,以学习清洁和退化表述之间的文字条件绘图;(3) 快速空间增强,以不同难度来丰富降解提示;(4) 以可控降解生成的文本条件合成,以支持课程学习。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Underwater Image Enhancement
blocks.zh: 2.1 水下图像增强

blocks.en:
Traditional UIE methods are typically built upon the underwater image formation model that characterizes light scattering and absorption.
Early works such as underwater dark channel prior Drews et al. (2013) , red channel prior Galdran et al. (2015) , and blurriness-based estimation Chiang and Chen (2011) estimate the transmission map and background light to remove haze and recover true colors.
More recent prior-based methods further exploit illumination characteristics to handle non-uniform lighting and color degradation Hou et al. (2023) ; Zhou et al. (2025b) .
However, their performance heavily depends on accurate estimation of water parameters and scene depth, limiting their robustness across varying underwater conditions Liu et al. (2020) .
Deep learning has revolutionized UIE by providing strong nonlinear modeling and robust feature representation capabilities.
Early convolutional methods Li et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2021) ; Wang et al. (2021) ; Zhang et al. (2022) ; Wei et al. (2022) employed encoder–decoder or multi-branch architectures to learn direct mappings from degraded to clean images, achieving improved contrast and color fidelity through illumination modeling and multi-level feature learning. Adversarial and generative frameworks Fabbri et al. (2018) ; Wang et al. (2019) further enhanced perceptual realism but often introduced instability and color over-saturation.
Moreover, some works use contrastive learning Zhou et al. (2024) ,
domain priors, and external knowledge to improve UIE generalization
and controllability.
PhaseFormer Khan et al. (2025) introduces phase-based attention to preserve structural cues, while CLIP-UIE Liu et al. (2025) utilizes semantic guidance from vision-language models. Semantic-Guided Diffusion Zhou et al. (2025a) leverages multimodal cues from LLaVA and Zip-CLIP to generate semantic heatmaps for diffusion guidance.
blocks.zh:
传统的UIE方法通常建立在水下图像形成模型上,这种模型是光散射和吸收的特点。
早期作品有"水下暗道前德鲁斯等"(2013年),"红色通道前高德兰等"(2015年)等;"以模糊度为基础的估计"(Chiang and Chen(2011年)估算出传输图和背景光来去除雾霾并取回真实颜色.
更近期的以往方法进一步利用照明特性来处理非统一照明和颜色退化问题 侯等 (2023年); 周等 (2025年b).
然而,它们的性能严重依赖于对水参数和场景深度的准确估计,限制了它们在不同的水下条件下的稳健性Liu等人(2020年).
深度学习通过提供强大的非线性模型和强壮的地物表现能力,使UIE发生了革命性的变化.
早期演化方法:李等 (2020年);李等 (2021年);王等 (2021年); 王等 (2021年); 李等. 张等 (2022年); 魏等. (2022年)使用编码器-解码器或多分支架构来学习从退化到清洁的图像的直接映射,通过发光模型和多层次的特征学习,实现更好的对比和色彩忠实. 逆境和基因框架 Fabbri等 (2018年); Wang等 (2019年) 进一步强化了观念现实主义,但往往带来不稳定和色彩过饱和.
此外,一些作品使用对比性学习周等 (2024) ,
域前科和外部知识,以提高UIE的通化
和可控性。
阶段前置 汗等编. (2025)引入了基于相位的注意来保存结构提示,而CLIP-UIE Liu等. (2025)使用视觉语言模型的语义指导. 语义- Guided Difusion Zhou等 (2025a) 利用LLaVA和Zip-CLIP的多模式提示来生成语义热图来进行传播指导.

blocks.en:
Recent studies highlight the role of generative priors and degradation modeling in diffusion-based image restoration Li et al. (2025) .
Underwater-specific approaches, including WF-Diff Zhao et al. (2024) and SLURPP Wu et al. (2025) , exploit diffusion models for underwater enhancement.
Related diffusion-based restoration methods further explore degradation-model optimization Fei et al. (2026) , global brightness alignment Guo et al. (2026) , and blur-decoupled learning Cheng et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh:
最近的研究强调了基因学前科和降解模型在以扩散为基础的图像恢复Li等(2025)中的作用.
水下特有方法,包括WF-Diff Zhao等 (2024)和SLURPP Wu等. (2025),为水下增强利用扩散模型.
基于扩散的相关恢复方法进一步探索退化模型优化. Fei等人(2026年),全球亮度对接 郭等人 (2026年),和模糊脱钩的学习 程等 (2026) (中文(中国大陆) ).

blocks.en: Despite these advances, the effectiveness of related UIE methods remains largely constrained by the availability and diversity of training data.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但有关的世界信息倡议方法的有效性仍然在很大程度上受到培训数据的提供和多样性的限制。

blocks.en: 2.2 Underwater Image Synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.2 水下图像合成

blocks.en:
The scarcity of paired and diverse underwater data has motivated the research on underwater image synthesis.
Early physics-based methods simulate light attenuation using simplified water models but fail to reproduce complex scattering Ye et al. (2022) ; Li et al. (2020) .
Alternatively, some datasets create pseudo-references by applying multiple UIE methods to a degraded image and having a user select the best outcome as the “clean” target Li et al. (2019a) . While visually plausible, this approach is fundamentally limited as it provides no insight into the forward degradation process itself. It merely offers a single, fixed enhancement target for each input, failing to model the diverse and controllable degradation attributes (e.g., water type, turbidity) that are crucial for robust generalization.
GAN-based approaches Li et al. (2017) ; Islam et al. (2020) improve realism but suffer from domain bias and unstable training.
Recent diffusion-driven frameworks, including Atlantis++ Zhang et al. (2026) and TIDE Lin et al. (2025) , enable text- or depth-conditioned underwater scene synthesis.
However, these methods focus on generating underwater scenes rather than modeling controllable degradations.
Our work uniquely fills this gap by introducing a controllable, text-driven degradation diffusion model that synthesizes diverse and realistic underwater degradations, providing richer supervision and significantly enhancing the generalization of UIE models.
blocks.zh:
缺乏成对和多样的水下数据推动了对水下图像合成的研究。
早期以物理为基础的方法利用简化的水模型模拟光衰减,但未能再现Ye等人(2022年);Li等人(2020年).
或者,有些数据集通过将多种UIE方法应用到已退化的图像上,并让用户选择最佳结果作为"干净"的目标Li等人(2019年a)来创建伪引用. 这种方法虽然看似可行,但根本上是有限的,因为它无法深入了解未来退化进程本身。 它只是为每项投入提供一个单一的固定增强目标,未能模拟对强性通化至关重要的多种可控降解属性(如水型,多发性等).
基于GAN的方法Li等人(2017年);Islam等人(2020年)改进了现实主义,但因领域偏差和培训不稳定而受到影响.
近期的推广驱动框架,包括亚特兰蒂斯++ 张等 (2026)和TIDE Lin等 (2025),使文字或深度有条件的水下场景合成成为可能.
然而,这些方法侧重于产生水下场景,而不是模拟可控制的退化.
我们的工作通过采用可控制、由文字驱动的降解扩散模型来填补这一空白,该模型综合了多样和现实的水下降解,提供了更丰富的监督,并大大地加强了UIE模型的普及。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Our methodology addresses the challenges of underwater image enhancement through a two-stage framework. First, to overcome the bottleneck of limited diversity and fixed degradation patterns in existing datasets, we introduce a Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation (TCDA) pipeline. This pipeline synthesizes a vast and diverse corpus of degraded images with controllable degradation attributes specified by fine-grained text prompts.
Second, leveraging this augmented data, we employ a progressive degradation curriculum to train a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion (TG-Diff) model, designed for transmission-guided image restoration with greater inference efficiency than multi-step diffusion methods.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法通过一个两阶段框架来解决水下图像增强的挑战。 首先,为了克服现有数据集中多样性有限和固定退化模式的瓶颈,我们引入了 " 文本有条件的退化增强 " 管道。 这种管道合成了大量、多种多样的已退化图像,带有精细的文字提示所指定的可控制的降解属性。
第二,利用这种扩大的数据,我们使用逐步降解课程来培训一种传输导出单步分流(TG-diff)模型,该模型旨在传输导出图像修复,其推论效率高于多步骤分流方法。

blocks.en: 3.1 Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation
blocks.zh: 3.1 文本条件降解增强

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , our TCDA pipeline establishes a controllable mapping between clean images, their degraded counterparts, and textual degradation prompts.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们的TCDA管道在清洁图像、其退化的对应物和文字退化的诱因之间建立了可控制的绘图。

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Degradation Captioning via MLLMs
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 通过微额供资引起的降解

blocks.en: We first collect a large-scale dataset of 12,483 degraded–clean image pairs from four representative underwater datasets: UIEB Li et al. (2019a) , EUVP Islam et al. (2020) , LSUI Peng et al. (2023) , and 3D TURBID Duarte et al. (2016) . To ensure fair evaluation, only the training subsets of UIEB and LSUI are used.
blocks.zh: 我们首先从四个具有代表性的水下数据集中收集了由12 483个退化的 -- -- 干净图像对组成的大规模数据集: UIEB Li等(2019年a),EUVP Islam等(2020年),LSUI Peng等人(2023年),以及3D TURBID Duarte等人(2016年). 为确保公平评价,只使用UIEB和LSUI的培训子集.

blocks.en: To create rich, structured textual representations of the visual degradations, we employ a multimodal large language model (Gemini 2.5-Flash Team (2025) ) to generate fine-grained captions. These captions describe six core degradation attributes: turbidity level, color-cast type and severity, density of suspended particles, lighting conditions, degree of haze or backscatter, and extent of contrast reduction.
blocks.zh: 为了创造视觉退化的丰富,结构化的文字表现,我们采用了多模式的大型语言模型(Gemini 2.5-Flash Team (2025))来生成精细的字幕. 这些标题描述了六个核心降解属性:多发性水平、彩色播报类型和严重程度、悬浮颗粒密度、照明条件、雾度或后向散射程度以及对比还原程度。

blocks.en:
To obtain more consistent captions, we guide the MLLM to describe degradation cues only, while excluding scene content.
This process yields a dataset of triplets { I deg i , I clean i , T deg i } i = 1 N \{I^{i}_{\text{deg}},I^{i}_{\text{clean}},T^{i}_{\text{deg}}\}_{i=1}^{N} , where the text T deg i T^{i}_{\text{deg}} provides fine-grained supervision that directly links semantic attributes to visual degradation patterns, forming the foundation for our text-conditioned diffusion modeling. Details about the prompt design are provided in Supplementary Sec. 2.1.
blocks.zh:
为了获得更一致的字幕,我们引导MLLM只描述降解提示,同时排除场景内容.
这个过程生成一个三重奏的数据集 { I deg i, I clean i, T deg i} i = 1 N {i^{i}_{\text{deg}}, I^{i}_{\text{ clean}}, T^{i}_{\i}_{\text{deg}}\}_{i=1}^{N} ,其中文本 T deg i T^{i}_{\text{deg}}}提供了精细的监管,直接将语义属性与视觉退化模式联系起来,构成了我们文字条件传播模型的基础. 关于迅速设计的细节见补充第2.1节。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Flow-Based Degradation Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 基于流量的退化模型

blocks.en: Building upon the constructed triplets, we develop a text-conditioned diffusion framework to learn the mapping from clean to degraded representations. To model this directed transformation, we adopt a flow-based diffusion framework based on FLUX.1 Kontext Labs et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 在已建成的三胞胎基础上,我们开发了一个文字有条件的传播框架,以学习从清洁到退化的绘图。 为了建立这种定向转变的模式,我们采用了基于FLUX.1 Kontext Labs等人(2025年)的流传播框架。

blocks.en:
Unlike traditional denoising-based models, flow-matching directly learns the vector field from a source to a target distribution, offering a more stable and efficient training objective for this task. Specifically, the clean image I clean I_{\text{clean}} and degraded image I deg I_{\text{deg}} are encoded into compact latent representations x 0 x_{0} and x 1 x_{1} via a pre-trained VAE encoder. Concurrently, the textual description T deg T_{\text{deg}} is encoded by frozen dual text encoders (T5-XXL Raffel et al. (2020) and CLIP-L Radford et al. (2021) ) to obtain an embedding c c . The model learns a conditional velocity field v θ ​ ( z t , x 0 , t , c ) v_{\theta}(z_{t},x_{0},t,c) that drives the transformation of x 0 x_{0} towards x 1 x_{1} under text guidance. We adopt a flow-matching objective as ℒ degrade = 𝔼 t , x 0 , x 1 , c ​ [ ‖ v θ ​ ( z t , x 0 , t , c ) − ( ε − x 1 ) ‖ 2 2 ] , \mathcal{L}_{\text{degrade}}=\mathbb{E}_{t,x_{0},x_{1},c}\big[\|v_{\theta}(z_{t},x_{0},t,c)-(\varepsilon-x_{1})\|_{2}^{2}\big], (1) where z t z_{t} denotes the intermediate latent state at timestep t t , and ε ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \varepsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1) represents the stochastic noise.
This formulation enables the model to learn a text-conditioned degradation vector field that reflects both the deterministic transformations described by the text and the stochastic variations inherent to real-world degradations.
To enhance training efficiency and reduce computational overhead, we adopt parameter-efficient fine-tuning with LoRA Hu et al. (2022) .

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Controllable Degradation Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 可控制的退化综合

blocks.en: To fully leverage our text-conditioned degradation model, we construct a structured prompt bank. Specifically, instead of relying on unconstrained free-form prompts, we organize the prompt space around six degradation attributes, including turbidity, color cast, particles, lighting, haze/backscatter, and contrast. For each attribute, we define phrases with different severity levels and group them into three difficulty tiers, i.e., easy, moderate, and hard, so that the resulting prompts are both semantically coherent and explicitly controllable. Each prompt is a tuple T deg = ( a 1 , … , a K , d ) T_{\text{deg}}=(a_{1},\ldots,a_{K},d) , detailing key attributes { a k } \{a_{k}\} and a difficulty level d ∈ { easy , moderate , hard } d\in\{\texttt{easy},\texttt{moderate},\texttt{hard}\} . During synthesis, given a clean image I clean I_{\text{clean}} and any such prompt T deg T_{\text{deg}} , our model generates a corresponding degraded image I deg I_{\text{deg}} . This text-driven paradigm not only enables fine-grained semantic control over degradation types and intensities but also provides the multi-difficulty data crucial for our progressive enhancement training, as detailed next. Representative prompt-conditioned degradation results are shown in Figure 4 . Detailed design is described in Supplementary Sec. 2.2.
blocks.zh: 为了充分利用我们的文本条件退化模型,我们建立了一个结构化的快速银行。 具体来说,我们不依赖不受约束的自由式提示,而是围绕六个降解属性来组织即时的空间,包括:扰动、彩色铸造、粒子、照明、雾霾/后散射和对比等。 对于每一个属性,我们定义了不同严重程度级的短语,并将其分入三个难度级,即:简单,中和,硬等,这样产生的提示既能凝聚出一致又能明确控制. 每个提示是 tuple T deg = (一个 1, ..., a K, d) T_{\text {deg { (a_{ 1},\ ldots, a_{K}, d), 详细列出关键属性 { a k k} \{a_{k}\}和困难级别 d∈ { 简单,中度,硬 } d\in\{\textt{easy},\textt{mederate},\ttt{hard} 。 在合成过程中, 我们的模型生成了一个相应的退化图像 I dig IQQText{deg}。 这种由文字驱动的范式不仅能够对降解类型和强度进行精细的语义控制,而且还提供了对于我们逐步增强培训至关重要的多难度数据,详情如下。 具有代表性的快速降解结果见图4。 详细设计见补充第2.2节.

blocks.en: 3.2 Progressive Degradation Curriculum Learning
blocks.zh: 3.2 逐步退化课程学习

blocks.en: Directly training a restoration model on the full, diverse spectrum of degradations generated by TCDA can lead to instability and slow convergence. To address this, we introduce a progressive degradation curriculum that leverages the difficulty levels defined in our prompt bank. This curriculum gradually increases the degradation complexity during training, allowing the model to first master fundamental color and tone restoration before tackling more complex scattering and contrast loss.
blocks.zh: 直接就TCDA产生的各种退化进行恢复模型的培训,可能导致不稳定和缓慢的趋同。 为了解决这个问题,我们采用了一种渐进式的退化课程,利用我们快速银行确定的难度水平。 这种课程在训练期间逐渐地增加了退化的复杂性,使得模型在解决更复杂的散射和对比损失之前,首先能掌握基本颜色和声调恢复.

blocks.en: Specifically, for each difficulty level d ∈ d\in { easy , moderate , hard }, we formulate a sampling schedule that dynamically adjusts the selection probability P τ ​ ( d ) P_{\tau}(d) as a function of the normalized training progress τ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \tau\in[0,1] : P τ ​ ( d ) = exp ⁡ ( α p ⋅ s d ​ ( τ ) ) ∑ d ′ exp ⁡ ( α p ⋅ s d ′ ​ ( τ ) ) , P_{\tau}(d)=\frac{\exp\big(\alpha_{p}\cdot s_{d}(\tau)\big)}{\sum_{d^{\prime}}\exp\big(\alpha_{p}\cdot s_{d^{\prime}}(\tau)\big)}, (2) where α p \alpha_{p} is a temperature factor controlling the transition sharpness, which we set to 5.0 in our experiments to ensure a smooth yet effective curriculum, and s d ​ ( τ ) s_{d}(\tau) is the preference score for difficulty d d . To realize a smooth shift, we instantiate the scores as: s easy ​ ( τ ) \displaystyle s_{\text{easy}}(\tau) = cos 2 ⁡ ( π ​ τ 2 ) , \displaystyle=\cos^{2}\!\left(\frac{\pi\tau}{2}\right), (3) s moderate ​ ( τ ) \displaystyle s_{\text{moderate}}(\tau) = sin ⁡ ( π ​ τ ) , \displaystyle=\sin(\pi\tau), s hard ​ ( τ ) \displaystyle s_{\text{hard}}(\tau) = sin 2 ⁡ ( π ​ τ 2 ) , \displaystyle=\sin^{2}\!\left(\frac{\pi\tau}{2}\right), This formulation enables a smooth and interpretable evolution of the training data distribution, allowing the model to gradually adapt to increasingly complex degradations. As shown in Figure 3 , the continuous evolution of sampling probabilities promotes progressive robustness across diverse underwater conditions.

Figure 5: Visual comparisons with state-of-the-art UIE methods on the UIEB dataset. Our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art UIE methods for underwater images with varying degrees of degradation.

blocks.en: 3.3 Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion
blocks.zh: 3.3 传播 -- -- 引导一阶扩散

blocks.en: To bridge the gap between physics-agnostic diffusion models and restoration with greater inference efficiency than multi-step diffusion methods, we propose Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion (TG-Diff). Our framework builds upon the single-step SD-Turbo architecture Sauer et al. (2024) , which we adapt to the UIE task. Runtime and model-complexity comparisons are provided in Supplementary Sec. 3.1. We freeze the pre-trained weights and apply LoRA Hu et al. (2022) with a rank of 32 to both the U-Net and the VAE encoder.
blocks.zh: 为了以比多步骤传播方法更高的推论效率来弥合物理-不可知扩散模型与还原之间的差距,我们提议传输-引导一步骤传播(TG-diff). 我们的框架建立在单一步骤SD-Turbo建筑Sauer等(2024年)之上,我们适应了UIE的任务。 运行时间和模型复杂度的比较载于补充第3.1节。 我们冻结了预先训练过的重量,并将Lora Hu等人(2022年)的军衔为32名,用于U-Net和VAE编码器.

blocks.en:
To provide the diffusion model with a dense spatial prior on attenuation and scattering, we condition it on a transmission map 𝒯 \mathcal{T} estimated via the UDCP method Drews et al. (2013) . This strategy provides the model with a physics-inspired cue about spatially varying water properties.
To achieve this, the map is downsampled to the latent resolution and concatenated with the image latent z deg z_{\text{deg}} , forming an expanded 5-channel input x = [ z deg , 𝒯 latent ] x=[z_{\text{deg}},\mathcal{T}_{\text{latent}}] where new channel weights are zero-initialized.
blocks.zh:
为了在衰减和散射之前向扩散模型提供密集的空间,我们以通过UDCP方法Drews等人(2013年)估算的传输图T\mathcal{T}作为条件。 这一战略为模型提供了物理学启发的关于空间不同水特性的提示。
为了实现这个目标,地图被下至潜在解析度并被图像所缩合为: z- deg z-text{deg}}},形成一个被扩展的5个通道输入 x= [z-deg, T- expency] x= [z-_{\text{deg}},\ mathcal{T-}_{\text{latent}}] 其中新频道权重为零初始化.

In this process, an intermediate skip feature S i S_{i} is first generated from the encoder feature E i E_{i} via a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution. This feature is then added to the corresponding upsampled decoder feature U i U_{i} as: S i = Conv 1 × 1 ​ ( E i ) , U i ← Interp ​ ( U i ) + S i . S_{i}=\text{Conv}_{1\times 1}(E_{i}),\quad U_{i}\leftarrow\text{Interp}(U_{i})+S_{i}\ . (4)

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. In the TCDA pipeline, we utilize two NVIDIA A800 GPUs (80 GB) for training the degradation diffusion model. We adopt a LoRA fine-tuning strategy with a rank of 8. All the images are resized to 1024×1024 in the training process. The model is optimized using AdamW with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and a per-GPU batch size of 1. We train the model for two epochs. During inference, we employ 28 denoising steps for text-conditioned degradation synthesis.
For training the TG-Diff, we adopt the Stable Diffusion-Turbo Sauer et al. (2024) as our base model and fine-tune it with LoRA of rank 32. During the training process, the samples are randomly cropped into 256 × \times 256 patches from the original images.
We train the model for 50,000 iterations using the AdamW optimizer ( β 1 = 0.9 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{1}=0.9,\beta_{2}=0.999 ) with a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and a batch size of 12 per GPU. We optimize TG-Diff with the composite objective ℒ total = ℒ L1 + α ​ ℒ LPIPS \mathcal{L}_{\text{total}}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{L1}}+\alpha\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{LPIPS}} , which combines the L1 reconstruction loss ( ℒ L1 \mathcal{L}_{\text{L1}} ) and the LPIPS perceptual loss ( ℒ LPIPS \mathcal{L}_{\text{LPIPS}} ), with α = 3.3 \alpha=3.3 in all experiments.
blocks.zh:
执行细节。 在TCDA管道中,我们利用两个NVIDIA A800GPU(80GB)来培训降解扩散模型. 我们采取了一个LORA微调战略,等级为8等. 所有图像在训练过程中被调整为1024×1024. 该型号采用AdamW优化,学习率为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}每GPU批量尺寸为1. 我们训练两个时代的模型。 在推论期间,我们采用28个去名步骤进行文字条件的降解合成。
为了训练TG-Diff,我们采用稳定分化-Turbo Sauer等人(2024年)作为我们的基地模式,并与32等的LORA进行微调. 在训练过程中,样本被随机收成256×\times 256补丁从原始图像.
我们使用 AdamW 优化器(β 1 = 0.9,β 2 = 0.999\β1 = 0.9,\β2 = 0.999)来训练5万个迭代的模型,恒定学习率为 1× 10× 4 1× 10× 4. 我们优化了 TG-Diff 的复合目标 L 总计 = L1 + α LPIPS → mathcal{ L}_{\text {total}}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{L1}}+\alpha\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{LPIPS}}},将 L1 重建损失(L1\mathcal{L}_{\text{L1}})和LPIPS 知觉损失(LPIPS\mathcal{L}_{\text{LPIPS}})结合到所有实验中的 α = 3.3\alpha=3.3.

blocks.en:
Datasets and Evaluation Metrics. All images in the UIEB dataset Li et al. (2019a) are first divided into 790 images for training and 100 images for testing.
Based on 790 training images, we further utilize our text-conditioned degradation augmentation (TCDA) model to produce 10,270 augmented images. These augmented images are categorized into three difficulty levels (easy, moderate, and hard) with a ratio of 5:5:3.
To assess the benefit of TCDA, we train all underwater image enhancement models with and without 10,270 augmented images, and then evaluate them on the same UIEB test set.
For paired evaluations, we report PSNR Huynh-Thu and Ghanbari (2008) , SSIM Wang et al. (2004) , and LPIPS Zhang et al. (2018) to measure reconstruction fidelity. For unpaired evaluations, we employ two no-reference underwater quality metrics: UCIQE Yang and Sowmya (2015) and UIQM Panetta et al. (2015) .
In addition, we assess performance on the reference-free UIEB C60 subset Li et al. (2019a) and U45 dataset Li et al. (2019b) , using UCIQE and UIQM to measure enhancement quality under unpaired conditions.
blocks.zh:
数据集与评价计量. UIEB数据集Li等(2019a)中的所有图像首先被分为790个用于训练的图像和100个用于测试的图像.
根据790个培训图像,我们进一步利用我们的文本条件退化增强模型,制作10 270个增强图像。 这些增强的图像分为三个难度级(简单、中度和硬度),比例为5:5:3。
为了评估TCDA的好处,我们用和不使用10,270个增强图像来培训所有水下图像增强模型,然后在同一个UIEB测试集上对其进行评价.
关于配对评价,我们报告PSNR Huynh-Thu和Ghanbari(2008年),SSIM。 Wang等(2004年)和LPIPS Zhang等(2018年)衡量重建忠诚度. 对于未经证实的评价,我们采用了两个不参考的水下质量衡量标准:UCIQE Yang和Sowmya(2015年)和UIQM Panetta等人(2015年)。
此外,我们还评估了无参考UIEB C60子集Li等(2019年a)和U45数据集Li等(2019年b)的性能,使用UCIQE和UIQM测量无标条件下的增强质量.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with State-of-the-Arts
blocks.zh: 4.2 与艺术现状的比较

blocks.en: We compare our approach with several state-of-the-art UIE methods, including UIEC 2 -Net Wang et al. (2021) , SCNet Fu et al. (2022) , FiveA+ Jiang et al. (2023) , WF-Diff Zhao et al. (2024) , CE-VAE Pucci and Martinel (2025) , and Phaseformer Khan et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 我们的方法与几种最先进的UIE方法进行了比较,包括UIEC 2-Net Wang等(2021年),SCNet Fu等(2022年),FiveA+ Jiang等(2023年),WF-Diff Zhao等(2024年),CE-VAE Pucci和Martinel等(2025年),以及Stireformer Khan等(2025年).

blocks.en:
Quantitative Evaluation. The quantitative comparisons in Table 1 show that our method achieves the strongest overall performance across three underwater benchmarks.
On the paired UIEB dataset, TG-Diff further achieves the best SSIM (0.927), PSNR (22.341), LPIPS (0.129), and UCIQE (0.613) after applying TCDA. On the reference-free C60 and U45 benchmarks, our method also obtains the highest UCIQE and UIQM scores in most cases, indicating improved performance on these reference-free metrics. TCDA improves most reported metrics across the compared methods. A discussion of occasional UIQM decreases is provided in Supplementary Sec. 3.2.
blocks.zh:
定量评价。 表1中的定量比较表明,我们的方法在三个水下基准中取得了最强的总体性能。
在配对的UIEB数据集上,TG-Diff在应用了TCDA后还进一步实现了最好的SSIM(0.927),PSNR(22.341),LPIPS(0.129)和UCIQE(0.613). 在无参考C60和U45基准上,我们的方法也获得了大多数情况下最高的UCIQE和UIQM分数,表明在这些无参考度量标准上的性能有所改善. 技术数据交换改进了大多数比较方法报告的衡量标准。 补充第3.2节对偶而减少的UIQM进行了讨论。

blocks.en:
Qualitative Evaluation. Figure 5 presents visual comparisons on representative UIEB examples with different degradation levels.
Existing methods often suffer from distinct artifacts: UIEC 2 -Net tends to leave residual haze and muted colors, SCNet and FiveA+ may introduce over-enhancement or unnatural color shifts, WF-Diff and CE-VAE sometimes fail to fully recover fine structures, and Phaseformer, although stronger, still shows less stable restoration under severe degradations.
In contrast, our TG-Diff produces clearer visibility, more natural color balance, and better local detail recovery, as highlighted in the enlarged regions.
After incorporating TCDA, “Ours+TCDA” further improves restoration fidelity, especially in heavily degraded scenes, where it removes haze more thoroughly and recovers clearer textures and structures.
These results verify that the proposed data-centric curriculum not only improves objective performance but also leads to more visually reliable enhancement results.
blocks.zh:
定性评价. 图5对不同降解水平的具有代表性的UIEB实例进行了直观比较。
现有方法往往有不同的文物: UIEC 2-Net往往会留下残留的烟雾和变色,SCNet和FiveA+可能会引入过度增强或不自然的色彩相变,WF-Diff和CE-VAE有时无法完全恢复精细的结构,相变器虽然较强,但在严重退化的情况下仍然显示出不太稳定的恢复.
与此相对照,我们的TG-Diff能产生更清晰的能见度,更自然的颜色平衡,以及更好的本地细节恢复,在扩大的地区也凸显出这一点.
在纳入了TCDA之后,“我们+TCDA”进一步改善了恢复忠心,特别是在严重退化的场景中,它更彻底地去除烟雾并恢复更清晰的纹理和结构。
这些结果证实,拟议的以数据为中心的课程不仅能改善客观表现,而且还能产生更能看得到的可靠增强结果。

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation study on the key components of TG-Diff.
blocks.zh: 表2:关于TG-Diff关键成分的研究.

blocks.en:
Figure 6: Qualitative ablation study of the proposed TG-Diff components on the UIEB dataset.
The full model restores clearer structure, more natural illumination, and balanced color rendition.
blocks.zh:
图6:对UIEB数据集上拟议的TG-DIff组件进行定性消化研究.
完整的模型恢复了更清晰的结构,更自然地发光,以及平衡的色彩引渡.

blocks.en: Table 3: Quantitative comparison on LSUI Peng et al. (2023) . Best results are in bold.
blocks.zh: 表3:LSUI Peng等人(2023年)的定量比较. 最佳结果用黑体表示。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion. We investigate each TG-Diff component through the quantitative and qualitative results in Table 2 and Figure 6 .
Starting from the single-step backbone, making the encoder trainable improves feature adaptability, while adding skip connections further enhances structural fidelity.
Incorporating the UDCP prior improves SSIM and LPIPS while maintaining comparable PSNR, indicating complementary benefits from the transmission cue.
blocks.zh:
传播的有效性——指导一阶传播. 我们通过表2和图6中的定量和定性结果来调查每个TG-diff部分。
从单步主干线开始,使编码器可被列车改进了特性可适应性,而增加跳过连接会进一步提高结构的忠诚.
纳入UDCP前期改进了SSIM和LPIPS,同时保持可比的PSNR,表明传输提示的互补效益.

blocks.en:
To further validate the effectiveness of our TG-Diff, we conduct additional comparison experiments on the LSUI dataset Peng et al. (2023) , which contains 3,879 training images and 400 testing images.
As shown in Table 3 , our TG-Diff consistently outperforms representative UIE networks across both reference-based and non-reference metrics, demonstrating the superiority of our network design and its strong adaptability to diverse underwater conditions.
More visual comparisons are provided in Supplementary Sec. 4.1.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步验证我们的TG-Diff的有效性,我们在LSUI数据集Peng等(2023)上进行了更多的比较实验,其中包含3,879个训练图像和400个测试图像.
如表3所显示的,我们的TG-DIff在基于参考和非参考指标的具有代表性的UIE网络上的表现始终高于这些网络,表明我们的网络设计具有优越性,并能适应各种不同的水下条件。
补充第4.1节提供了更多的视觉比较。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Visualization of degradation generation across different difficulty levels. Conditioned on text prompts describing easy, moderate, and hard degradations, the model generates visually consistent degradation patterns with increasing severity.
blocks.zh: 图7:不同难度水平的退化产生可视化。 该模型以文字提示为条件,描述轻而易举、中而硬的退化情况,产生视觉上一致的退化模式,其严重程度也越来越大。

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation of degradation-difficulty sampling. Curriculum learning yields the best balanced performance.
blocks.zh: 表4:退化困难抽样的分布情况。 课程学习取得最佳平衡的业绩。

blocks.en: Table 5: Ablation on the augmented-to-original data ratio ( R Aug R_{\text{Aug}} ). Increasing the ratio of synthetic degradations improves overall enhancement quality.
blocks.zh: 表5: 增加的数据对原始数据比率的差额(R Aug R_{\text{Aug}}})。 提高合成降解率提高了整体提升质量.

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of Progressive Degradation Curriculum. We ablate the impact of the proposed Progressive Degradation Curriculum by comparing it with training on a single difficulty level. As shown in Table 5 ,
integrating curriculum learning yields the best overall performance by enabling progressive adaptation to degradations of varying difficulty.
blocks.zh:
逐步退化课程的有效性。 我们通过在单一难度水平上将课程与培训进行比较来减轻拟议的渐进退化课程的影响。 如表5所示,
综合课程学习可逐步适应各种困难的退化,从而取得最佳的总体业绩。

blocks.en: We further investigate the effect of the augmented-to-original data ratio ( R Aug R_{\text{Aug}} ) on model performance. As shown in Table 5 , enlarging the ratio from 1× to 3× and 5× generally improves restoration fidelity and perceptual quality.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查增强的数据比(R Aug R_{\text{Aug}}})对模型性能的影响。 如表5所示,将比例从1×提高到3×和5×普遍提高了恢复忠贞性和知觉质量。

blocks.en:
Analysis of Controllable Degradation Generation. As shown in Figure 7 , our diffusion-based degradation model provides fine-grained control over degradation severity.
Conditioned on prompts with increasing difficulty, it generates consistent degradation transitions from mild color distortion to severe scattering and contrast loss.
blocks.zh:
分析可控制的退化生成。 如图7所示,我们基于扩散的降解模型对降解的严重程度提供了精细的控制。
它以越来越困难的提示为条件,产生从轻度颜色扭曲到严重的散射和对比损失的持续降解过渡.

blocks.en:
To evaluate the distributional similarity of our synthesized degradations to real underwater images, we compare our text-driven degradation generation model with representative underwater image synthesis methods, including UWGAN Wang et al. (2019) , UWCNN Li et al. (2020) , and UWNR Ye et al. (2022) .
We compute the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) between generated degraded images and real underwater samples from the UIEB test set (100 images) and the LSUI test set (400 images).
As shown in Figure 1 , our model achieves a lower FID score than the compared synthesis methods, suggesting closer alignment with real underwater images in the Inception feature space.
blocks.zh:
为了评价我们合成的降解与真实水下图像的分布相似性,我们用具有代表性的水下图像合成方法,包括UWGAN Wang等(2019年),UWCNN Li等(2020年)和UWNR Ye等(2022年)来比较我们的文字驱动降解生成模型.
我们计算由UIEB测试集(100个图像)和LSUI测试集(400个图像)生成的退化图像与真实的水下样本之间的Fréchet摄入距离。
如图1所示,我们的模型的FID分数低于比较的合成方法,这表明与Inception特征空间中真实的水下图像更加一致.

blocks.en:
Validation of Degradation Difficulty Levels. We evaluate variations in the severity of our synthesized degradations using two non-reference underwater metrics: UCIQE, which reflects color fidelity and contrast, and UIQM, which measures perceptual sharpness and colorfulness.
As shown in Figure 8 , both scores decline consistently from easy to hard levels, indicating that the generated degradations exhibit controllable severity.
blocks.zh:
鉴定降解难度水平。 我们使用两个非参考水下测量值来评估我们合成降解的严重程度的不同:反映颜色忠和对比度的UCIQE和测量感知锐度和色度的UIQM。
如图8所显示的,这两个分数从容易降至硬度,这表明产生的退化显示出可控制的严重程度。

blocks.en: Effectiveness of the Pipeline. As shown in Table 6 , beyond FID, the TG-Diff model trained on our synthesized data achieves stronger enhancement performance than that trained on degradations generated by the representative baseline UWCNN.
blocks.zh: 管道的效能. 如表6所示,除FID外,经过综合数据培训的TG-Diff模型的增强性能比具有代表性的UWCNN基线产生的降解性能更强。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Trends of non-reference underwater image quality metrics under different degradation difficulty level settings. Both UCIQE and UIQM consistently decrease as the degradation difficulty increases from easy to hard.
blocks.zh: 图8:不同降解难度等级设置下不参考水下图像质量计量标准的趋势. UCIQE和UIQM都持续下降,因为降解难度从容易增加到困难.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we propose an explicit, controllable degradation modeling framework designed to alleviate the scale and diversity limitations of paired UIE data. We introduce TCDA to synthesize diverse underwater degradations with fine-grained textual control, a progressive degradation curriculum to organize these samples across attributes and difficulty levels, and TG-Diff to incorporate a transmission prior into one-step restoration. Together, these components convert controllable degradation modeling into structured supervision for robust UIE. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate improvements across most restoration and reference-free metrics, while the ablation studies examine the contributions of the curriculum, data augmentation, and transmission guidance. Future work will extend the framework to temporally consistent underwater video enhancement and broader real-world degradation conditions.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个明确、可控制的退化模型框架,旨在减轻成对的UIE数据的规模和多样性限制。 我们引入了TCDA,以精细的文字控制来合成各种水下降解,一个渐进的降解课程来组织这些样本跨越属性和难度水平,TG-Diff将传输先入为一步骤恢复. 这些组件一起将可控制的降解模型转换成结构化的监管,用于强大的UIE. 关于多种基准的实验表明,大多数恢复和无参考度量标准都有所改进,而减征研究则审查课程、数据增强和传输指导的贡献。 今后的工作将扩大该框架的范围,使之适用于水下视频的分时增强和更广泛的现实世界退化状况。
